sampling.method: Fixed-seed shuffle of cached Crossref top-500 topical queries (journal articles, 1990–2024). Excludes missing metadata, >40 authors, retracted works, titles with <5 content tokens, and titles outside Latin-script filter. Not a population-representative sample.

misjudged.raw: Ball H. Peper P. Alakbarova D. Gilbert S. Brewer G. A. &Brewer G. A.(2021).Individual differences in prospective memory offloading in laboratory and naturalistic settings (version 1).PsyArXiv Preprints.
misjudged.nearest: Individual differences in working memory capacity predict benefits to memory from intention offloading

definitions.falseAccusation: A genuine formatted reference classified No record found, divided by all genuine formatting trials.
definitions.detection: Fabrication flagged Details differ, Identifier conflict, or No record found. Details differ is a review warning, not an accusation of fabrication. Could not check is an abstention and stays in the denominator.
definitions.confusionMatrix: Rows are ground-truth groups; columns are all six output verdicts. Genuine trials accept Verified or Details differ.
definitions.uncertainty: Four formats of the same work are correlated. Synthetic fabrications and source-index overlap limit generalisation. No population-wide accuracy claim.

optionalSet.note: Separate real-world set. Ground-truth labels are GPTZero's claims, not independently adjudicated here. All extracted table rows included. Never pooled with synthetic hold-out metrics.
